page.overview:
Who is Darth Wyyrlok?

Darth Wyyrlok was a female Chagrian who served the Sith Lord Darth Krayt as a Sith Master. She became Krayt's closest advisor sometime after 41 ABY, following in the footsteps of her father, who had also been called Darth Wyyrlok. She additionally acted as Krayt's voice and the Regent of his Sith order while he rested in stasis. Wyyrlok eventually mothered a son, who assumed her name and duties before 130 ABY.

The female Her father was also called Darth Wyyrlok His duties were eventually passed down to his daughter, who became Krayt's most trusted advisor and acted as the guardian of the One Sith while her Master rested in stasis. The Sith remained hidden on the planet Korriban for a century, and as Krayt's order and his plans to conquer the galaxy developed and grew, Like her father before her, Wyyrlok became Krayt's voice and the regent of the One Sith during these periods. She had a son at some point, and after she passed away he assumed her name and responsibilities.

The Sith had red skin with black tattoos. She was loyal to Darth Krayt and waited for his commands.

Darth Wyyrlok was a Sith Master of the One Sith, an organization of Force-users deeply immersed in the dark side of the Force. Darth Krayt placed great faith in her ability to lead the Sith in his absence, appointing her as his voice and the regent of the order while he rested in stasis.
